newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Crown makes A$42.6 million placement.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Crown makes A$42.6 million placement.

text.p: Melbourne Casino operator Crown Ltd said on Friday it had placed 17.05 million ordinary shares at A$2.50 a share to raise A$42.625 million.
The issue represents 3.11 percent of expanded capital.
Crown said the placement, together with a placement that raised A$81.88 million on December 23, 1996, completed a 10 percent share issue.
The directors believed the completion of the issue would strengthen Crown's balance sheet, improve the financing mix and enhance its capacity to consider appropriate opportunities, Crown said.
Both placements were arranged by Prudential-Bache Securities (Australia) Ltd.
